title: Oct 3 Results + Oct 4 Preview: Three-for-Four Keeps the Lights On
summary: Oct 3 delivered a solid 3-1 showing. Tomorrow we're back on the Brewers.

content.value:
## Another Day at the Office

You know what I've learned after covering this game for more years than I care to admit? A 3-1 day is nothing to sneeze at. The young analysts get all worked up about perfection, but give me 75% accuracy over a long season and I'll show you a profitable model. October 3rd was one of those solid, workmanlike days that keeps the operation humming.

## The Only Miss Worth Mentioning

The Guardians pick at 52% was basically a coin flip with a mustache. When you're that close to even money, you're not really making a bold prediction—you're making an educated guess. The Sox came through and proved that low-confidence picks can bite you. I've seen this movie before, usually in September when teams are jockeying for position.

## The Hits That Mattered

The Dodgers pick at 65% was the anchor of the day—when you get your highest-confidence call right, everything else falls into place easier. The Rays and Brewers both came through in the 59-60% range, which is right in that sweet spot where the model tends to shine. Not cocky, not timid. Just solid handicapping.

## Looking Ahead to October 4

Here's something interesting: we're going right back to the Padres-Brewers well tomorrow. Michael King takes the hill for San Diego against Logan Henderson for Milwaukee. The model likes the Brewers again, but barely—we're talking 50% confidence here, which is essentially telling us this game could go either way.

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick
content.value: Milwaukee Brewers over San Diego Padres
content.sub: 50% confidence · King vs Henderson · American Family Field

content.value:
## The Henderson Factor

Logan Henderson's been a revelation for the Brewers this season, though he doesn't get the headlines. Michael King has the pedigree and the stuff, but Milwaukee at home in October is a different animal. I've seen American Family Field swallow up better road teams than these Padres.

That said, 50% confidence means exactly what it sounds like—this is a lean, not a lock. If you're looking for a slam dunk tomorrow, keep looking. If you trust the process and understand that October baseball is about marginal edges, well, this is what those edges look like.

## Final Thoughts

Three-for-four yesterday keeps us in the black. Tomorrow's pick requires a bit of faith. That's baseball in October—sometimes the model whispers instead of shouts, and you have to decide if you're listening.

See you after first pitch.
